articles.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal
articles.snippet: The token hit a $25 million market cap on the back of nine days of unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI footage. Its creator has now sold his stack — hours before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal.

articles.title: Crypto traders brace for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech
articles.snippet: One analyst expects Warsh to take a tough line on inflation, but still sees the Fed holding off on rate hikes until at least after the November mid-term elections.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $80,000 as stocks close with gains
articles.snippet: U.S. spot bitcoin funds have taken in $2.8 billion since the run began, and ether ETFs are matching it day for day. Three sessions are left to make August their best month since October 2025.

articles.title: Bithumb wins 2 suits over mistaken Bitcoin credits: Report
articles.snippet: Bithumb reportedly won first-instance rulings in two suits seeking proceeds from users who sold Bitcoin credited in its $40 billion error.

articles.title: Tokenized deposits could raise US credit costs: Dallas Fed economists
articles.snippet: Dallas Fed economists said faster, programmable deposits could make bank funding less stable, potentially pushing lenders toward more expensive funding.
